properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated Wednesday, November 15, [1933],  on stationery from the Peninsula Hotel in Kowloon, Hong Kong; includes description of upcoming events in Macao, Canton [Guangzhou], and the return to Shanghai.
